decision.rationale: The dispute is in time. TXN-008050 (17.44 EUR, IRONBRIDGE AUDIO, card CRD-000097) posted on 2026-09-01, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-30. That is 59 days later, inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The charge was made on 2026-08-31. The merchant's cancellation confirmation, DOC-000055, says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-04, which is after the charge. So the charge covers a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge, the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: Ironbridge Audio charged 17.44 EUR on 2026-08-31. Their written confirmation shows your cancellation took effect on 2026-09-04, after that date. The charge therefore covers a period before your subscription was cancelled.
